title: chamissoa maximiliani var. celosioides
intro: Chamissoa maximiliani var. celosioides, commonly known as False Celosia, is a plant species in the Amaranthaceae family. It is known for its medicinal properties and has been used in traditional medicine to treat various ailments. The health benefits of this plant include anti-inflammatory, antiseptic, and antioxidant properties, which may help to reduce fever, alleviate pain, and protect against cell damage. The bioactive constituents present in False Celosia include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which are responsible for its therapeutic actions such as antimicrobial and anti-inflammatory effects.
